user.title: MyUsage account
user.description: Sign in with the email and password you use at myusage.com (not your OUC/myOUC login). Register a MyUsage login with your email first if you normally reach the dashboard through the OUC portal button.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate MyUsage
reauth_confirm.description: The MyUsage password for {email} is no longer accepted. Enter the current password.

error.invalid_auth: MyUsage rejected the email or password.
error.unsupported_account: Signed in, but this account did not land on the postpaid usage app (multi-utility or prepay accounts are not supported yet).
error.unknown: Unexpected error; check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This MyUsage account is already configured.

init.title: MyUsage Archive options
init.description: The portal publishes once a day around 10:30 AM Eastern with a two-day lag. One fetch per day, shortly after that, is all the data supports. The backfill asks the portal once for its daily history (about 15 months) and fills the Energy dashboard with one bucket per day for days older than the 15-minute window; set it to 0 to disable.

data.jitter_minutes: Random delay added to the fetch time (minutes)
data.keep_raw_pages: Successfully parsed raw pages to retain per kind (failed pages are always kept)

layout_error.title: MyUsage page layout changed
layout_error.description: The MyUsage page for {email} no longer matches a layout this integration understands ({error}). Nothing was archived from it, and the raw page was kept in the archive for diagnosis. Please report this with the anonymized capture from `myusage-archive probe`.

export_halted.title: MyUsage statistics export halted
export_halted.description: The statistics for {statistic_id} could not be reconciled with the archive ({reason}). Export of that series is paused so the Energy dashboard is never rewound. This clears itself once the archive catches up (the next successful fetch, at the latest tomorrow's slot). If it persists, delete the statistic under Developer tools → Statistics and reload the integration to rebuild it from the archive.

unsupported_account.title: MyUsage account not supported
unsupported_account.description: Signing in as {email} worked, but the account did not land on the postpaid usage app: {error}. Multi-utility and prepay accounts are not supported yet.

stale_archive.title: MyUsage archive is stale
stale_archive.description: No new usage data has been archived for {email} in over {hours} hours. The portal's 7-day window means data older than a week can no longer be recovered. Check the Home Assistant log for fetch errors.
